books.name: Model book: the watchlist in equal weights
books.note: Illustrative. ₹500 crore bought in equal weights at the prices of the 2026-10-09 run; nobody holds it. Replace it with real positions, bearing in mind this file is public.

scenarios.label: Nifty 50 falls 10%
scenarios.basis: Each holding moves by its beta to the benchmark; 3 holdings without 26 weeks of prices are taken at 1.0.

scenarios.label: Every holding back at its 52-week low
scenarios.basis: Each holding's lowest weekly close of the last year; 1 holding without a range is left unchanged.

scenarios.label: The worst 4 weeks of the last year again
scenarios.basis: Today's weights through the weeks of 2025-12-29 to 2026-01-23.
